user_impact: Visual bleeding of tap/hover highlight and active states outside rounded borders on mobile devices
affected_urls: All pages (buttons cards chips tags nav)
evidence: Interactive buttons cards and chips lacked overflow hidden and border-radius inheritance on stretched links
root_cause: Native tap highlights and absolute pseudo-elements not constrained by container border radius
remediation: Add overflow:hidden and border-radius:inherit to pseudo-elements and global tap-highlight-color:transparent

user_impact: Exceeding 45.0 KB CSS budget risks parse overhead on constrained CPUs
evidence: /css/*.css uncompressed size reached 45.63 KB against 45.0 KB budget
root_cause: Redundant selector declarations comments and unreferenced primitive variables
remediation: Consolidate shared selectors via :is() eliminate unused primitive tokens

user_impact: Client framework runtime bloats mobile main thread and degrades INP
evidence: Verification of _astro/ directory for client-side JS bundles
root_cause: Accidental introduction of client:load or client:idle components
remediation: Strict CI budget requiring 0 KB framework runtime

user_impact: Delayed LCP on hero panel avatar
root_cause: Missing explicit fetchpriority="high" or potential lazy-loading of hero image
remediation: Ensure fetchpriority="high" explicit width/height and responsive WebP variants

user_impact: Repeat visitors re-downloading static CSS/JS/images on subsequent visits
root_cause: Missing 1-year immutable caching on versioned static assets
remediation: Declare Cache-Control: public max-age=31536000 immutable in netlify.toml
